cause_claim: There are two identically-named bundle_fields tables: one in database r0 (140 columns) and one in database default (140 columns). The baseline experiment (x-b4312b498e574a2d) shows bundle-builder reads 140 entries. The candidate experiment (x-b5ebcd2a70e84c06) with GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader shows bundle-builder reads 280 entries — the grant makes r0.bundle_fields accessible in addition to the already-accessible default.bundle_fields, doubling the entry count. worker-runtime max_entries=200 is exceeded (280 > 200), causing exit code 2: "fatal: bundle has 280 entries but the runtime preallocates 200; refusing to start".
